d: India’s poverty rate has fallen from 27.1% in 2011 to 2.6% in 2023, according to the World Bank’s October 2026 Poverty and Equity Brief, with an estimated 496 million people moving above the lower-middle-income poverty line. Firstpost examines the drivers of this progress, alongside income inequality, wage gaps and youth unemployment. Meanwhile, Delhi is set to ban non-BS-VI-compliant vehicles from entering the capital from November 1 as part of its winter air pollution action plan. Hem Kaur Saroya explains which vehicles will be restricted, how owners can check their BS-VI compliance and…
